mainSubject.label: Companions of the right placed among thornless lote trees, layered fruit-trees, extended shade, poured water and abundant fruit neither seasonal nor forbidden, upon raised beds; the women of Paradise produced in a new creation as devoted virgins of equal age for a company drawn from both former and later peoples; companions of the left consigned to scorching wind, scalding water and a shade of black smoke neither cool nor beneficial, because they had indulged in affluence, persisted in the great violation and denied resurrection of themselves and their forefathers; the answer that former and later peoples alike are gathered for a known Day's appointment; the astray deniers eating Zaqqum until bellies are filled and drinking scalding water like thirsty camels as their accommodation on the Day of Recompense

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the peace-only speech of the forerunners (26) before the companions-of-the-right block opens (27); P2 ends with the Zaqqum accommodation verdict (56) before the four evidentiary challenges begin (57); P3 runs through seed, sowing, water and fire to the first exaltation command (57-74); P4 covers the star-oath, protected Register, deathbed scene, threefold outcome and the closing exaltation (75-96).
